name: Zindabaagh
tagline: Free tools and plain-language guides for studying, working and living in Germany.

tools.title: Visa Route Finder
tools.short: Answer a few questions and see which German visa fits your plan.

tools.title: German Grade Converter
tools.short: Convert your GPA or percentage to the German 1.0 to 4.0 scale.

tools.title: Blocked Account Calculator
tools.short: How much you need in your Sperrkonto, in euros and in your own currency.

tools.title: Blue Card Salary Check
tools.short: Check a job offer against this year's EU Blue Card salary thresholds.

tools.title: Opportunity Card Points
tools.short: Count your Chancenkarte points and see if you reach the minimum.

tools.title: Net Salary Calculator
tools.short: Estimate your take-home pay after German tax and social contributions.

tools.title: First Weeks Planner
tools.short: Your to-do list after landing, with the Anmeldung deadline worked out.

tools.title: PR & Citizenship Timeline
tools.short: See the earliest dates for a settlement permit and a German passport.

services.title: Free evaluation
services.text: Tell us about your education, work and goal. We tell you which route to Germany is realistic for you and what to do first.
points: A short form, about three minutes
A personal answer by e-mail or WhatsApp
No payment and no obligation

services.title: Study visa: admission only
services.text: We find programmes that fit your grades and budget and handle the applications until you hold an admission letter.
points: Shortlist of matching universities and programmes
Grade conversion and document check
Applications through uni-assist or directly to the university
Motivation letter and CV review

services.title: Study visa: full service
services.text: Everything in the admission service, plus your visa file and interview preparation, until you are ready to fly.
points: Everything in admission only
Blocked account and health insurance set-up
Complete visa document file, checked against your embassy's list
Visa interview guide and a practice interview
First-weeks plan for after you land

services.title: Opportunity Card (Chancenkarte)
services.text: We check your points, tell you how to reach six, and prepare your application file for the Opportunity Card.
points: Points check and a plan to close the gap
Help with the recognition or ZAB statement for your qualification
Complete application file for the online portal
Job-search plan for your first months in Germany

services.title: German CV review
services.text: German employers expect a particular CV format. We review yours line by line and send it back ready to use.
points: Written feedback on structure, content and wording
German-style layout that applicant tracking systems can read
Tips for your LinkedIn profile

services.title: 1-on-1 call
services.text: A video call about your own case: your options, your documents, your next three steps. Bring every question you have.
points: One call, fully about your situation
A written summary of your next steps afterwards

services.title: ExamKlar: German exam practice
services.text: Mock exams in the Goethe and telc format from A1 to B2, vocabulary training and grammar chapters. Free to start.
